9.3.2 Irrelevant communication in slave nodes
This section is only applicable to LIN slave nodes. The third direction for a LIN frame is that the frame is not relevant for the slave node and is ignored. After a received LIN header is indicated by the LIN driver, the PID is evaluated (shown by function EvaluatePID). If it’s determined to belong to an Irrelevant frame, the LIN interface informs the driver about the response type by setting the appropriate members of PduPtr (shown by function SetPduPtrValues). No further action is made (Figure 9.7).
